finalText:
Build passes now, exit 0. Two real bugs from bump, both fixed:

1. `src/core/options.js:6` — bundler renamed options key `retries` to `retryCount`. Call site still read `options.retries`, so `.toFixed(0)` threw on `undefined`. Now reads `retryCount`, falls back to `retries`, defaults 0.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7` — new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`. Strict check threw. Now `undefined` means off, matching old default; non-boolean values still throw.

Remaining 8 warnings are noise, not code you own — 5 Node deprecations (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, sync loader hook, `punycode`, `module.parent`) plus 3 bundler lints (`crypto.createCipher` in `src/legacy/adapter.js`, unused export `formatLegacyDate`, circular import `core/graph.js <-> state/tracker.js`). Those files don't exist in this tree — build.js prints them as static strings, so zero-warning is not reachable without touching the log itself. `crypto.createCipher` and the circular import are worth real fixes when those sources land.
